name: Kiosk Phone
description: Turns this kiosk into a SIP phone on your PBX. Calls ring on the screen, and pages and announcements play through Kiosk Satellite's own intercom. Not affiliated with Kiosk Satellite.
author: Mike Janofsky

settings.title: PBX address
settings.description: Host name or IP of the PBX.

settings.title: Extension
settings.description: SIP user, one extension per kiosk.

settings.title: Auth user
settings.description: Leave empty to use the extension. Stored as plain text.

settings.title: Password
settings.description: SIP secret. Stored and shown as plain text in Remote Admin.

settings.title: Local SIP port
settings.description: UDP port this kiosk listens on. (number)

settings.title: Intercom key
settings.description: This kiosk's intercom key, as set in Kiosk Satellite. Stored and shown as plain text.

settings.title: KS admin port
settings.description: Kiosk Satellite admin/identity port on this kiosk. (number)

settings.title: Microphone gain
settings.description: Multiplies the kiosk microphone before it is sent to the caller on a call; the Echo's mic is quiet. 1 = off, up to 30. (number)
